retrievalProfile.description: A low-key, high-contrast portrait of a male subject against a dark, textured background featuring expressive script lettering and a central numeric accent.
triggerTerms: dark textured photography with white lettering

recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, close-up portrait of a man looking downward, illuminated by a single directional light source that creates deep shadows. The image is characterized by a heavy film grain or paper texture and features a prominent, hand-drawn script title across the lower third with a contrasting red numeric element.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed downward creates a somber, reflective mood
High-contrast lighting separates the subject from the near-black background
White script typography provides a sharp, organic contrast to the dark photographic base
A single red accent color breaks the monochromatic palette to emphasize a specific character
coreInvariants: Heavy monochromatic film grain texture across the entire composition
Directional lighting leaving one side of the face in deep shadow
Lower-third placement for all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered portrait, medium close-up, occupying the top two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the gold chain pendant acting as a central vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the illuminated face, follows the chain down to the pendant, and settles on the large script title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark, textured negative space surrounding the subject, particularly on the right and top.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and white (highlights and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying stroke weights
letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected strokes for the main title
Rough, distressed edges suggesting hand-painted or ink-drawn origins
Elongated descenders and ascenders that overlap slightly
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numeric character is significantly larger, thicker, and rendered in a contrasting color with a dry-brush texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for the title paired with a bold, condensed sans-serif for metadata/advisory labels.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory badge in bottom left

avoid: Clean, modern sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the organic, hand-painted movement of the lettering
Matches the rough edges and fluid connections

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a man looking down, lit from the side with high contrast. Apply a heavy black-and-white film grain texture over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, hand-drawn white script title in the lower third. Include a large, distressed red number in the center of the text string. Place a standard parental advisory badge in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast and directional?
Is the grain texture visible across the whole image?
Is the script text distressed and organic?
Is the red numeric element significantly bolder than the white text?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible despite the distress
Ensure the grain doesn't obscure facial features
Verify the red accent provides enough contrast against the dark background
Confirm the composition feels bottom-heavy due to the typography
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key portrait + heavy grain + distressed script overlay + single color accent.
